changes: brp.json is transcribed by hand from the document, for a world before firearms: the skills (each "various" skill given the specialties such a world uses; modern skills left out), ancient and medieval weapons and armour, the damage modifier table, the professions such a world has (each "choose from" list resolved to fixed picks; Doctor becomes Healer), the four personality types, sample characters and natural animals, and the major wound table summarised.
Powers (magic, sorcery, psychic abilities, mutations, superpowers), hit locations, fatigue and sanity are not included.

resolution.die: d100 roll-under against a skill or a characteristic roll
